name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 45 – Am 59
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 45a. Emphasises that continued migration from radical Islamic countries, such as Afghanistan, to Europe risks importing fundamentalist Sharia laws, thus undermining women’s rights in Europe; urges Member States to halt the mass influx from these countries, primarily composed of young adult males; calls for the rapid and effective implementation of measures to readmit migrants posing a threat to European security and the enforcement of readmission agreements for illegal migrants;
